recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. It completes the requested clarifications without changing bindings or adding new artifacts. Future tooling may still tighten the ElementDefinition.type.code value set if a reusable "FHIR types except interfaces" value set is introduced.
issue_request: FHIR-37791 was Published / Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested explicit behavior for interfaces in StructureDefinition.context, SearchParameter.base, Reference.type, ElementDefinition.type.code, ElementDefinition.type.profile, ElementDefinition.type.targetProfile, and inherited constraints in snapshots.
initial_application: The original application appears to be git ee6ec073accca8c31e7cec29cc2f722d870ec109, titled "37791 - interface documentation", which added interface examples to StructureDefinition notes. Later related commits handled some adjacent behavior, including concrete-vs-all resource type bindings and Reference.type guidance, but the current source still lacked explicit guidance for several named fields.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2022-08-15 confirmed the 15-0-0 Persuasive with Modification vote. FHIR-32069, FHIR-28411, FHIR-46620, and FHIR-51035 provide supporting and later context for concrete resource types, extension contexts, and interface base-type rules. No direct Zulip mention of FHIR-37791 was found.
reconciliation: Updated active build inputs for extension context, SearchParameter.base, Reference.type, ElementDefinition.type.code/profile/targetProfile, and StructureDefinition notes to state the approved interface behavior and snapshot constraint propagation.
source_changes: source/defining-extensions.html: clarified that interface extension contexts apply only to implementing resources that have the referenced path.
source/searchparameter/structuredefinition-SearchParameter.xml: clarified that SearchParameter.base may name abstract/interface types and then applies to implementing resources.
source/datatypes/reference.xml: clarified that Reference.type in resources must name a concrete, non-abstract resource type, not an interface.
source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml: clarified that ElementDefinition.type.code cannot name interfaces, while type.profile and type.targetProfile may name interfaces.
source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-notes.xml: documented how interface constraints propagate into snapshots and retain ElementDefinition.constraint.source.

related_jiras.note: Separated concrete ResourceType from all resource types, supporting SearchParameter.base allowing abstract/interface types while Reference.type remains concrete.
Clarified that Reference.type in FHIR resources must be a FHIR resource type from ResourceType.
Later clarified extension context specialization and interface contexts.
Later clarified that interfaces are not valid baseDefinition targets for additional resources.
